integrity: All claims in the present result concern the same three-angle distribution. The accompanying checker only performs finite exact examples; universal claims rely on an explicit mathematical proof. No independent audit or historical-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Canonical unweighted coordinate Euclidean realization; graphs simple, bipartite, without isolated vertices. Not a claim for weighted graphs, arbitrary affine images, or ridge Hausdorff measures. The edge-facet subcount and the star specialization occur in previous literature.
title: Three-angle ridge spectra and four-cycle reconstruction for bipartite stable-set polytopes
